notes: Every persona signed in through the portal's own OAuth flow (citizens: mobile + OTP read from the simulated SMS gateway; officers: departmental login) and every action went through the real MCP servers over streamable HTTP.
Assistants ran in scripted-policy mode: each persona's steps were executed deterministically through the real MCP client. The Director's own agent will drive the same endpoints with a live LLM.

The under-60 persona (Sunita) was refused by the portal's own validation; the Borgaon persona (Pratima) was refused by the agent-channel pilot-block rule; the duplicate persona (Girish) was told about his existing APPROVED application.
Officer decisions require a concrete reason — it is written into the audit trail against the officer's name, as the Director asked.
